verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents running code in an isolated sandbox, with stateful REPL and stateless Cmd contexts and custom images, so it delivers the core of executing code. Specific language runtimes and structured or rich outputs are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit Python/JavaScript/multi-language runtime support, rich result outputs (charts, images, structured data), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back

citations.quote: A sandbox gives a user's AI agent an isolated cloud computer where it can run code, install software, manage files, and control network access.
Each context runs a process and can be either a **REPL** (stateful) or **Cmd** (stateless) type.
Sandbox0 accepts public images and team-scoped private images and imports their RootFS into the regional block store before runtime use.
